title: Chapter 234 Human Heavy Cavalry
content:
Chapter 234 Human Heavy Cavalry

The battlefield outside the main city of the 108th area of the public battlefield in the southern theater.

The alien human army, which had lost all its powerful mages, seemed to have lost its stable and immovable momentum and became a little agitated.

The alien human army wanted to start with the attack of the strongest mage lineup and launch a Jedi counterattack against the Zerg army. Unexpectedly, the powerful mages all exploded inexplicably before they took action.

From the fact that the mages died of self-explosion and disappeared in light, it can be seen that this was the work of the Zerg army.

The strong men behind the two camps did not come forward, indicating that this attack may not be a means of the strong, but a means of the enemy army.

This cast a shadow on the always confident alien human army, and no one knew which strong man would disappear inexplicably in light next.

"Boom boom boom...!"

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Zerg destroyers were not polite, and their attacks never stopped.

The continuous explosions are also a huge drain on the priests in the alien army. They need to cast magic, treat the wounded, and purify the corrosive mucus.

The cavalry units in the phalanx of the alien army are all heavy cavalry, the elite among the elite, and very powerful.

Under the continuous attack of the Zerg destroyers, these heavy cavalry suffered the least losses.

The siege weapons in the alien army basically cannot reach the phalanx of the Zerg army, and the powerful trump card of the magician, which is highly expected, has not been able to play a role.

Now it is time for the powerful cavalry to charge and lead the alien army to attack the Zerg army.

The priests of the alien race have blessed nearly 200,000 heavy cavalry with various group magic.

These heavy cavalry are very pure, and the men and horses are all wrapped in heavy white iron armor. The weapons are only spears and knight swords, and all other unnecessary weights are abandoned.

The nearly 200,000 alien heavy cavalry, the strength of ordinary cavalry is two-star, and the strength of officers at all levels is stronger.

Their war horses are all high-quality war horses with star ratings, and snow-white hair can occasionally be seen through the thick and tight iron armor.

They are the core pillars of this alien army and the most powerful attacking force!

After being surrounded and beaten by the army of the local camp for so long, this heavy cavalry unit has never been dispatched once.

Now in order to eliminate the heresy of the Zerg army, the alien heavy cavalry will be dispatched.

"The alien cavalry unit is going to be dispatched!"

"Retreat quickly! Speed up!"

"I hope this new friendly army can resist!"

"..."

In front of the Zerg army, the local camp army, which was still organizing the retreat, saw that the alien heavy cavalry unit had all moved to the front of the formation and was ready to launch a charge, and they retreated faster.

The Zerg hive was upgraded to five stars. The Zerg army, which had just received a huge upgrade, arranged a defensive battle formation under the command of the queen, ready to meet the charge of the alien heavy cavalry.

The two-star Zerg cockroaches and Zerg hydralisks were still in the first line, facing the charge of the alien heavy cavalry head-on.

The one-star Zerg cockroaches and Zerg hydralisks were in the second line. The Zerg hydralisks in the second line were also responsible for providing anti-aircraft firepower for the Zerg destroyers to prevent the flying arms of the alien army from raiding the Zerg destroyers.

Ten thousand two-star Zerg stealth spiders burrowed underground in the first line. Their ground spike attacks were very effective against cavalry troops. They would give the alien heavy cavalry troops a surprise later.

The stealth spiders had already revealed the Zerg's ability to burrow underground in front of people, so Wu Qing no longer hid it and ordered 100,000 two-star Zerg puppies, most of which burrowed into the ground in front of the Zerg army's first line of defense and lurked underground, while a small number of them burrowed and lurked around the Zerg army.

"This Zerg army is really unique. It can hide underground and there is no flaw outside!"

"This ability is perfect for ambushes! It is simply a magical skill for ambush warfare!"

"Now they are sneaking underground so openly, they should want to put some pressure on the cavalry of the alien race!"

"The Zerg army that sneaked underground is not weak. It is indeed a big threat when it suddenly appeared!"

"This will make the cavalry of the alien race who knows this situation dare not charge at full speed, so they will shrink back!"

"It's clever, but just taking this trick can't stop the heavy cavalry of the alien race. The strength of those heavy cavalry is too strong!"

"It depends on the combat power of other Zerg arms!"

"..."

People who have had the honor of witnessing the powerful strength of the heavy cavalry of the alien race began to comment on the deployment of the Zerg army.

Wu Qing's consciousness has been attached to the Zerg clone and returned to the battlefield.

He looked at the Zerg Queen in the sky. Even if she was hiding, she had already been exposed to the eyes of all parties under the close scrutiny of all parties.

But no one knew what the ability of this Zerg army was, nor did they know that it was these very strange-looking Zerg that killed the alien mages.

Wu Qing let ten Zerg Queens fly into the loading space of the transport host and upgraded them inside, raising the strength of the ten Zerg Queens to five stars.

The Zerg Queen's hidden abilities such as one-hit kill, parasitic control, and reconnaissance can be exposed without being exposed.

If the Zerg Queen never shows her face to others, others will inevitably make suspicions about them.

Now the Zerg army has to face the charge of the powerful Tianwai Terran heavy cavalry force, which can just show off another powerful ability of the Zerg Queen.

The preparations for the Zerg army were completed, and the heavy cavalry units in the phalanx of the Tianwai Terran army, as well as the ground attack troops that followed, were deployed in place despite the constant attacks of the Zerg saboteurs.

The phalanx of the Tianwai human army faces the direction of the Zerg army, with nearly 200,000 heavy cavalry in front and a mixed formation of nearly 500,000 melee troops, crossbowmen, mages and army chaplains behind. They are ready to attack the Zerg army. The team prepares for a charge.

The troops in other directions of the Tianwai Human Army's phalanx cannot be mobilized for the time being. They are basically local camp troops who have experienced hundreds of battles. They will not miss this good opportunity and have been launching fierce attacks on the Tianwai Human Army in other directions.

Now the main focus of the Tianwai human army is on the Zerg army, which is a good time for the local camp army to attack.

As long as the Tianwai Human Race army dares to order a retreat, one improper operation can easily lead to a rout.

Therefore, the Tianwai Human Race will not mobilize troops from other directions unless it is absolutely necessary.

"Ugh...!"

The desolate attack horn of the Tianwai human army sounded.

"Guard the light!"

A dazzling white light lit up on the snow-white armor of the heavy cavalry of the outer human race!

The cavalry horses raised their hooves and neighed, and the whole body was also shining with white light. As soon as they took off, they were like arrows leaving their strings, and they charged towards the direction of the Zerg army square formation at extremely high speeds!

Viewed from a high altitude, the entire Tianwai Terran heavy cavalry unit looked like a thick white crossbow arrow, covered with white light, shooting towards the Zerg army!

The thick armor did not affect the speed of their charge at all.

Following closely behind the heavy cavalry of the Tianwai Human Race are the melee units of the Tianwai Human Race which are equally fast. While maintaining their attack formation, they can also keep up with the heavy cavalry at an extremely fast marching speed.

Comparing the two, it can be seen that the current charging speed of the Tianwai Human Clan's heavy cavalry troops is not their ultimate speed. They will definitely be able to accelerate even more when they reach the front of the formation.

The momentum of the entire Tianwai Terran heavy cavalry unit is integrated into one. When faced head-on, it will give people a sense of breathless oppression.

This made the soldiers of the local camp who were still evacuating no longer care about their formation and ran away to the side.

However, the Zerg army does not accept this!

"Rumble...!"

Nearly 50,000 liquid fireball shells fired by the Zerg saboteurs fell into the charging Tianwai Terran heavy cavalry troops.

With so many liquid fireball shells falling into such a small area, the explosion was extremely powerful.

Like iron beans shining with white light, a large number of the heavy-armed cavalry of the human race from outside the world were blown to the ground.

But these heavily armored cavalry of the outer human race cannot be measured against the capabilities of normal cavalry.

Except for a few who were directly killed and disappeared, the other injured cavalrymen who fell to the ground were not trampled by their companions behind them.

Those cavalrymen and horses are one, with superb riding skills and powerful strength. At the current speed, they can control the horses to rush and stop quickly, and avoid their fallen companions in front.

Their movements will not have much impact on the other cavalry charging from behind.

The injured heavy cavalry relied on its strong strength to stand up. The knight got on his horse, picked up his weapon, and continued to charge!

Believers who believe in the Lord of Light have very strong self-healing and recovery abilities, and they are also blessed by the divine magic of the military priests. This effect will be even more obvious.

Wu Qing observed through the Zerg host that the Zerg destroyers' concentrated fire attack actually killed about a thousand heavy cavalry of the Tianwai human race.

Most of the injured Tianwai human race heavy cavalry stood up again and continued to join the charging team.

"The defense capability of this Tianwai human army is really powerful!"

"The Zerg Destroyer's concentrated fire attack can't hit the surrounding friendly forces, and there's absolutely nothing they can do against these heavily armored cavalry!"

"As long as the Tianwai human army sends out this heavy cavalry force, any encirclement will be useless. No wonder they are confident!"

"Coupled with the powerful mage force that was wiped out, the bright gryphons that rivaled the Zerg flying dragons in the air, and nearly five million elite ground troops, we really have the capital to run rampant in this area!"

Wu Qing had a certain understanding of the Tianwai human army and had to admit how powerful this army was.
